t: This is The Pier Head Preparatory Montessori School, in Tower Hamlets. It takes the Montessori name from Maria Montessori, the Italian physician and educator. She was one of the first women to attend medical school in Italy, graduating with honors in 1896, and she became best known for her philosophy of education and her writing on scientific pedagogy. Her method is used in many public and private schools around the world, including this one.
